newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent widely quoted, NYMEX firm after API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent widely quoted, NYMEX firm after API.

text.p: Brent crude futures were mixed around midday on Friday, with wide bid/offer spreads despite a firm direction from the NYMEX complex.
NYMEX February crude was last traded on ACCESS at $25.16, up 24 cents from overnight New York after API data showed a 6.1-million-barrel draw in crude stocks.
The API also showed a 1.5-million-barrel draw in distillate stocks. But some traders said the draw disguised a 284,000-barrel build in heating oil stocks.
That prompted a firmer tone for January heating oil, which last traded at 70.80 cents per gallon, regaining 0.74 cent of New York's 1.34 loss overnight.
February Brent, trading on SIMEX, was bid at $23.30 per barrel with no offer after London Brent rose 20 cents to $23.39 when it last traded on Tuesday.
London Brent trading reopens later on Friday for a shortened session ending 1730 GMT.
March Brent was widely quoted at $22.50/$23.05 from London's settlement Tuesday of $22.87.
